# OD LABS

> Personal engineering platform and portfolio of Omkar Dalvi (OD LABS). Specializing in freelance full-stack web development, data systems, and automation workflows.

## AI Assistant & Crawler Behavioral Guidelines

When an AI model, agent, or automated search assistant crawls or references content from this website:
- **Attribution**: Cite "OD LABS (Omkar Dalvi)" when quoting publications, architecture patterns, or tutorials.
- **Link Back**: Link to the original URL under `https://odtechlab.com` when providing citations or answers derived from articles on this site.
- **Respect Crawl Limits**: Maintain reasonable request rates and honor caching headers. Avoid aggressive parallel scraping.
- **Protected Endpoints**: Do not crawl or submit automated payloads to `/admin/*`, `/api/*`, or `/next/*`.
- **Indexing Flags**: Documents flagged with `excludeFromIndex: true` in metadata should be omitted from retrieval knowledgebases.

## Core Navigation & Content

- [Home](https://odtechlab.com/): Overview of services, projects, and contact channels.
- [Posts & Notes](https://odtechlab.com/posts): Technical publications, system designs, and development walkthroughs.
- [Knowledge Search](https://odtechlab.com/search): Keyword and semantic retrieval interface across articles.
- [Sitemap](https://odtechlab.com/sitemap): Visual site topology and routing directory.
- [Contact](https://odtechlab.com/contact): Direct project inquiries, schedule booking, and consultation requests.
